items.text: From 31 January 2020, adults 18 and over in the ACT aren't committing an offence by possessing up to 50 g of dried cannabis (150 g harvested but not dried), or by growing one or two plants, as long as they're not grown artificially. More than four plants at one home, and smoking cannabis in a public place or near a child, are offences.
